EmailTemplate.subject: New Linkedin Live Event w/ Cerner Tomorrow!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Join us for our next installment of Healthy Bites: Live. In this bite-sized session, we are joined by Stephen Farrell, Executive, and Senior Director of Revenue Cycle and Ambulatory at Cerner as we discuss how to develop the right ecosystem of solutions that drive transformation in the billing and payment process and help providers give consumers the financial experience they desire.
You won’t want to miss it!]
When: April 21st at 12 pm est.
Where: Linkedin
Register Here: https://www.linkedin.com/events/designingaconsumerfocusedfinanc6786313533370970112/
Duration: 15 minutes.
